pie: ḱḗr wih₁néh₁ méwdt. wéyh₁onm̥ ḱéywoh₁ ḱóm ph₃dʰí. h₁ím mē dʰrugʰyés. dh₃éntu h₁ésmey téwe bʰoh₂góm. ḱwṓ poh₂imnéy ḱéywos. dusḱléwēs wiHrós ne ḱéywos.
english: Wine makes the heart joyful. Drink wine with a friend. Do not deceive him. Give him your portion. The dog is dear to the shepherd. A man of ill fame is not friendly.

pie: h₂ówis, (H)yésmin h₂wlh₂néh₂ ne éh₁est, dedorḱe (h₁)éḱwons, tóm, wóǵʰom gʷérh₂um wéǵʰontm, tóm, bʰórom méǵoh₂m, tóm, dʰǵʰémonm h₂oHḱú bʰérontm.
english: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

pie: ph₂ter nos déwks h₁éḱwons-kʷe nos dédeh₃s. h₂lékses nos memn̥mé te. sríHgos nos lémbʰt nu sédyomes HrudHmés-kʷe. nu nos kʷís bʰéh₂ti wédʰeti-kʷe nos?
english: Father, you led us and gave us horses. You protected us; we remember you. Cold has seized us. Now we sit and cry. Who now speaks for us and leads us?

pie: wr̥ǵyé. h₂éǵrom h₂érh₃ye. h₁yós h₂érh₃yeti só h₁ḗdti. gʷṓs h₂ml̥ǵdʰí. déme ǵʰórtom. h₁éḱwons yugdʰí. h₁yós wr̥ǵyéti só swóm bʰoh₂góm h₁áyto.
english: Work. Plough the field. Whoever ploughs, eats. Milk the cattle. Build the enclosure. Harness the horses. Whoever works takes his share.

pie: "súHnum wēlh₁mi."
english: "I want a son."

pie: ǵérh₂ont ph₂ter mérs polh₁úh₂ yéh₁ōr widés. nu sénōm wékʷesh₂ ǵn̥néh₃s. wédʰes nos séds wérh₁s-kʷe nos. nu te deywṓs h₁áyn̥to h₁nómn̥ toy ḱlutóm.
english: Old father, you have died. You saw many years, and then you knew the words of the old. You led us. You sat down, and you spoke to us. Now the gods have taken you. Your name is famous.

pie: súHnuh₁ h₁mé ḱlutóm. bʰréh₂tēr lewbʰós. téwe bʰréh₂term̥ mē linkʷtóm. dwóh₁ bʰréh₂terh₁e steh₂róh₁. ḱóm h₁édtom ḱóm píph₃etom. h₁yós h₁ím linékʷti só wĺ̥kʷos.
english: Two sons, hear me. A brother is dear. Do not leave your brother. Two brothers are stout. Eat together, drink together. Whoever leaves him is a wolf.

pie: téwe bʰoydʰéh₂m ph₂sdʰí. bʰoydʰéh₂ méǵh₂ih₂. bʰoydʰéh₂m mē Hrunéps. dyḗws ph₂tḗr dedórḱe. h₁yós bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépti stunédti pérkʷunos h₁ím. h₁yós bʰoydʰéh₂m péh₂sti h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm.
english: Guard your pledge. A pledge is great. Do not break the pledge. Father Sky sees. Whoever breaks a pledge, Perkunos strikes him. Whoever guards the pledge, his name is famous.

pie: h₁ógʷʰey l̥gʰdʰí ḱóm wiHróm mē lémbʰs. h₁ógʷʰey h₁yós kʷsépi sérpesi mē stéh₂s. pérkʷune toy h₁ógʷʰim ǵʰoysóh₁ stunddʰí. h₁ógʷʰey bʰugdʰí nu h₁ógʷʰis h₂epó léyttu.
english: Snake, lie down! Do not seize this man! Snake, you who creep in the night, do not rise! Perkunos, strike the snake with your spear. Snake, flee! Now let the snake go away.

pie: ḱḗr mē tréms ḱḗr mē bʰéyh₂s. h₂énǵʰos ḱr̥dés h₁éǵʰs gʷh₂dʰí. h₂éwsos sóh₂wl̥-kʷe h₂énǵʰos ḱr̥dés h₁l̥h₂tóm. nu gʷm̥yéh₁t swépnos h₁ésmey. dáḱruh₂ tr̥syéh₁t nu mudyéh₁t.
english: Heart, do not tremble! Heart, do not be afraid! Grief, go out of the heart. Dawn and Sun, drive the grief out of the heart. Then let sleep come to him. Let the tears dry up. Now let him become joyful.

pie: h₁yós uh₃wé h₂éǵet HéHḱuh₁ h₁éḱwoh₁ só mr̥wós. yugóy stesth₂é uh₃wé-kʷe kʷis ne yéwgt. nu h₂isḱétes h₁éḱwoh₁ h₁ím. h₁éḱwoh₁ ne h₁édtes kʷékʷlos stestóh₂e.
english: He who drove you is dead, swift horses. You two stand at the yoke, and no one has yoked you. Now the horses look for him. The horses do not eat. The wheel stands still.

pie: súHnew mē mérs gʷíh₃we h₂uksdʰí-kʷe. téwe te méh₂tēr h₂lékseti. dyḗws te dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe ph₂sih₁tā́m. nu h₁éytu h₂énǵʰos wĺ̥kʷom. ǵʰwḗr h₁íd h₁ḗdtu gʷh₂te h₁ím dʰgʷʰh₂dʰí. dyéw h₁uséwōm déh₃tor h₁ésmey séǵʰos dh₃dʰí.
english: Son, do not die! Live and grow! Your mother protects you. May Sky and Earth guard you. Then let the suffering go to the wolf. Let the wild beast eat it. Death, pass him by! Dyeus, giver of good things, give him power.

pie: mŕ̥we póh₂imen h₂éǵroy ḱéyth₂er. ḱwṓ toy sédyetes HréwdHti-kʷe. nu h₁regʷesyéti ne h₁édn̥ti h₂óweyes. wĺ̥kʷos h₁r̥sḱéti h₁íh₂n̥s-kʷe kʷis ne péh₂sti. h₁nómn̥ toy h₂nr̥sú ḱlutóm.
english: Dead shepherd, you lie in the field. Your dog sits and cries. Now it is getting dark; the sheep do not eat. The wolf approaches, and no one guards them. Your name is famous among men.

pie: péh₂wr̥ wódr̥ h₃sth₁sú dr̥mdʰí. h₁íd h₃sth₁í studyéh₁t gʷm̥yétu sríHgos. gʷʰr̥nós bʰéwgtu swidyétu. péh₃tu térptu-kʷe mē trésoyh₁t.
english: Fire in the bones, run into the water! Let it grow cold in the bone. Let the cold come, let what is warm flee. Let him sweat, let him drink and be satisfied. Let him not tremble.

pie: h₁ésh₂r̥ sth₂dʰí h₁ésh₂r̥ h₁éǵʰs mē gʷéh₂s. h₁yós ǵʰoysós twé térh₃t só Hrumpih₁tó. h₁rudʰéh₁n̥t kréwh₂s sn̥h₁wéni sth₂éh₁yoyh₁t. ḱludʰí dyéw ph₂ter ḱód wékʷos. h₁ím h₂lékse h₁éy-kʷe Hwr̥dʰyéh₁t.
english: Blood, stand still! Blood, do not go out! The spear that wounded you, let it be broken. Let the red blood stand in the sinew. Father Sky, hear this word! Protect him, and let him become strong!

pie: gʰostéyey wódr̥ wéyh₁onm̥-kʷe dh₃dʰí. h₁éy diwés h₁ludʰét. h₁ím mē dʰréwgʰs. sodéye h₁ím téwe stóloy. h₁ím téwe ḱóymōd h₁éǵʰs mē h₁élh₂s. h₁yós ḱóymos gʰostéyey dédeh₃ti só deywóybʰos lewbʰós. gʰóstis dh₃tr̥bʰós memóne.
english: Give the guest water and wine. He comes from Dyeus. Do not deceive him. Seat him at your table. Do not drive him out of your household. The household that gives to the guest is dear to the gods. The guest remembers the giver.

pie: wĺ̥kʷe wr̥h₁énm̥ mē lémbʰs ḱwón péḱu ph₂sdʰí. póh₂imen gʷṓs ḱóymom dukdʰí. mē h₁r̥sḱóyh₁t ǵʰwḗr h₂énti. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ bʰuHyóyh₁t ḱwón bʰéwdʰe. nu h₂óweyes pl̥h₁ih₁ént.
english: Wolf, do not seize the lamb! Dog, guard the herd. Shepherd, lead the cattle home. Let the wild beast not come near. Let the wool grow. Dog, be awake. Now let the sheep grow full.

pie: wíHre kúdʰe h₂epó gʷéh₂s? dʰéǵʰōm méh₂term̥ ní gʷā́m. nu toy kʷís gʷṓs h₂éǵeti? méne swēḱurós h₁íns h₂éǵeti. nu toy kʷís wékʷesh₂ bʰéh₂ti? h₃rḗǵs h₁íh₂ bʰéh₂ti kʷíd bʰéresi? ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos bʰéroh₂ h₁íd ne mr̥yétor.
english: Hero, where did you go away to? To Mother Earth I went down. Who now drives your cattle? My brother-in-law drives them. Now who speaks your words? The king speaks them. What do you carry? I carry imperishable fame. It does not die.

pie: bʰréh₂ter sn̥gʷóntm̥ twé widóm. h₂énti stestóh₂h₂e ne-kʷe te h₂léksom. bʰérom te h₂éǵrōd h₂éǵros toy kréwh₂s péh₃t. nu h₂epó h₁éymi memónh₂e-kʷe te. ḱléwos-ge toy ń̥dʰgʷʰitom.
english: Brother, I saw you falling. I stood near, and I did not protect you. I carried you from the field. The field drank your blood. Now I go away, and I remember you. Your fame indeed is imperishable.

pie: súHnew méne wékʷos ḱludʰí. h₁sónt wékʷos h₁wésu. h₁sónt wéwke. ḱéywom mē dʰréwgʰs. h₁yós h₁sónt bʰéh₂ti só deywóybʰos lewbʰós. h₁yód wékʷos h₁éǵʰs gʷéh₂t ne gʷm̥yéti tód h₂ew. ḱludʰí nu bʰh₂dʰí.
english: Son, hear my word. A true word is good. Say the truth. Do not deceive a friend. Whoever speaks the truth is dear to the gods. The word that goes out does not come back. Hear, then speak.

pie: h₁súḱlewes súHnew HéHḱew. ne ǵorh₂éyeth₂e dréms ǵʰoysós-kʷe te térh₃t. h₁rudʰéh₁n̥t kréwh₂s h₂éǵroy h₁ésti. nu te ne widéh₁yomes. gʷh₂tós te sléh₂gʷt h₁nómn̥ toy ḱlutóm.
english: Son of good fame, swift one, you did not grow old. You ran, and the spear wounded you in the field. Your blood is red on the field. Now we do not see you. Death seized you. Your name is famous.

pie: deywóybʰos némos dh₃dʰí. tóy h₁uséwōm déh₃tores. ǵʰutóm tóybʰos lewbʰóm. tóy déh₃torm̥ dedr̥ḱḗr. ḱléwseti dyḗws ph₂tḗr déh₃torm̥. deywóns mē dʰrugʰyés. dʰéǵʰōm méh₂tēr h₂nérn̥s bʰéreti.
english: Give worship to the gods. They are givers of good things. A libation is dear to them. They see the giver. Father Sky hears the giver. Do not deceive the gods. Mother Earth carries the men.

pie: nu h₃ésth₁ h₁ésh₂r̥ snéh₁wr̥-kʷe. h₃ésth₁ h₃sth₁éh₁ yungih₁tó nu h₁ésh₂r̥ h₁sh₂énh₁ yungih₁tó. snéh₁wr̥ sn̥h₁wénh₁ yungih₁tó. h₁yód h₃ésth₁ Hrumptó tód h₂ew sth₂éh₁yoyh₁t. dʰéǵʰom méh₂ter h₂énǵʰos h₃sth₁és h₁áyso. h₁yós ḱéyor stéh₂tu gʷm̥sḱétu-kʷe.
english: Now: bone, blood and sinew. Let bone be joined with bone. Then let blood be joined with blood. Let sinew be joined with sinew. The bone that broke, let it stand up again. Mother Earth, take the pain from the bone. Let him who lies there stand up and walk.

pie: h₁yós gʷíh₃weti só mr̥yétor. mr̥wṓs h₂ew ne gʷm̥yónti. h₁áyto gʷh₂tós sénom HeHḱúm-kʷe. pl̥h₁éwih₂n̥s kʷsépn̥s mē HréwdHs. h₂énǵʰos léytt sóh₂wl̥-kʷe gʷm̥yéti.
english: Whoever lives, dies. The dead do not come back. Death takes the old and the swift. Do not weep for many nights. Grief goes, and the sun comes. Dawn follows the night.

pie: h₁éḱwōs tu wewkond: "ḱludʰí, h₂owey! tód spéḱyomes, n̥sméy agʰnutór ḱḗr: dʰǵʰémō, pótis, sē h₂áwyes h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ gʷʰérmom wéstrom wept, h₂áwibʰyos tu h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ né h₁esti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: péyh₂wr̥ mē pléh₁dʰes péyh₂wr̥ ní gʷh₂dʰí. nu péyh₂wr̥ tinh₁dʰí. wódr̥ péyh₂wr̥ h₂epó bʰéretu. sríHgos péyh₂wr̥ lémbʰtu. gʷr̥h₃étu ǵʰwḗr péyh₂wr̥ gʷíh₃wetu.
english: Swelling, do not swell! Swelling, go down! Swelling, now melt! Let the water carry the swelling away. Let the cold seize the swelling. Let the wild beast devour the swelling. Let him live.

pie: wódr̥ ní h₁éyti ph₂wénbʰos úd h₁éyti. péh₂wr̥ wódr̥-kʷe ne ḱéywoyh₁. sóh₂wl̥ h₁éyti nókʷts-kʷe gʷm̥yéti. ḱéleti nókʷts bʰórm̥. h₂éwsōs h₁íh₂m̥ sékʷetor.
english: Water goes down; fire goes up. Fire and water are not friendly. The sun goes, and the night comes. Night covers the thief. Dawn follows it.

pie: kʷŕ̥mey h₁yós h₃ésth₁ h₁ḗdsi mr̥dʰí. kʷŕ̥mey h₁yós h₁ésh₂r̥ píph₃esi n̥ḱéntu. nu péh₂wr̥ twé dʰégʷʰetu. sóh₂wl̥ twé h₂sowséyetu. h₁pyéh₁t h₂éwis twé sn̥h₁wéns h₁éǵʰs h₁n̥dʰdʰí. h₃sth₁és h₁n̥dʰdʰí snéh₁wr̥ mē gʷr̥h₃és.
english: Worm, you who eat the bone, die! Worm, you who drink the blood, vanish! Then let fire burn you, let the sun dry you. Let the bird seize you. Come out of the sinew! Come out of the bone! Do not devour the sinew.
